method: Disease-specific synthesis of ClinGen VCEP/GCEP statements, gnomAD v4.1.1 constraint and ClinVar gene-wide variant spectrum; VCEP applicability overrides numerical triage

groups.applicability_source: General ACMG/AMP mechanism review; no MYBPC3-specific ClinGen VCEP rule was identified
groups.review_summary: ClinGen states that LoF is the HCM mechanism and that missense, nonsense, frameshift and splice variants can be pathogenic. ClinVar is strongly enriched for pathogenic truncating variants, but pathogenic missense and benign missense variants are both established; therefore PVS1 mechanism is established, while neither generic PP2 nor BP1 is met automatically.

sources.title: ClinVar gene-wide spectrum queries
sources.version: retrieved 2026-09-16; pathogenic missense 37, benign missense 35, pathogenic truncating 940

groups.applicability_source: ClinGen Cardiomyopathy VCEP MYH7 specification v2.0.0
groups.review_summary: The MYH7 VCEP explicitly marks PVS1, PP2 and BP1 Not Applicable. Regional missense enrichment is handled by PM1, so the high gnomAD missense Z score must not be double-counted as PP2.

sources.title: ClinGen Cardiomyopathy VCEP specifications for MYH7

groups.applicability_source: ClinGen TNNI3–HCM Gene-Disease Validity mechanism statement plus ClinVar spectrum
groups.review_summary: ClinGen reports a likely dominant-negative mechanism and that 91% of reported disease mutations are missense. The reviewed ClinVar query found 57 pathogenic/likely pathogenic versus 2 benign/likely benign missense VCVs. PP2 is supported; BP1 and PVS1 mechanisms are not.

sources.title: ClinVar gene-wide spectrum queries
sources.version: retrieved 2026-09-16; pathogenic missense 57, benign missense 2, pathogenic truncating 23

groups.applicability_source: ClinGen DSG2–ARVC Gene-Disease Validity and disease-relevant variant-class review
groups.review_summary: DSG2 is definitively associated with ARVC and both decreased product level and altered sequence/missense mechanisms are reported. Benign missense variation is not low in the reviewed ClinVar spectrum, and the disease is not exclusively or safely modeled as truncating-only; PP2 and BP1 are not met.

sources.title: Inherited cardiac disease mechanism and variant classes
sources.version: 2023; DSG2 decreased product level and altered sequence

sources.title: ClinVar gene-wide spectrum queries
sources.version: retrieved 2026-09-16; pathogenic missense 7, benign missense 40, pathogenic truncating 126

groups.applicability_source: Disease-context review: KCNJ5 validity is for familial hyperaldosteronism, not HCM
groups.review_summary: ClinGen supports KCNJ5 gain-of-function missense variation for familial hyperaldosteronism type III, not hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The case source also treats this finding as phenotype-mismatched; HCM PP2/BP1 must not borrow the hyperaldosteronism mechanism.

sources.title: ClinGen KCNJ5–familial hyperaldosteronism type III Gene-Disease Validity

groups.review_summary: The definitive MYBPC3–HCM mechanism must not be transferred to the ARVC case. ClinGen classifies the MYBPC3–ARVC relationship as Limited, so PP2/BP1 are not applicable for this demo assessment.

groups.applicability_source: Disease-context review: definitive TNNI3 validity is for HCM, not ARVC
groups.review_summary: The definitive TNNI3–HCM dominant-negative missense mechanism must not be transferred to the ARVC case. No condition-matched ClinGen relationship was identified for this review, so PP2/BP1 are not applicable.
